Privacy Policy

How Blast Blitz handles your information

📋

Overview

P-01

Blast Blitz is an offline block puzzle game developed by Core Nova Systems (package: com.choco.blockblitz). This Privacy Policy explains what information is stored, how it is used, and what choices you have.

✅ Short version: Blast Blitz does not collect any personal data, does not require an account, and does not connect to the internet. All data stays entirely on your device.

By installing or using Blast Blitz, you agree to this Privacy Policy. If you disagree, please uninstall the application.

🗂️

Information Stored on Your Device

P-02

Blast Blitz saves only the minimum data needed for the game to work. All of it is stored locally using Android SharedPreferences (key: BlockPuzzlePrefs) — never uploaded anywhere.

Best Score Your highest score ever, shown on the home screen. Local only
Last Level The last level you reached, to track progression. Local only
Sound Setting Whether in-game sound effects are on or off. Local only
Vibration Setting Whether vibration feedback is on or off (setting only — no VIBRATE permission is used). Local only
Animations Setting Whether UI animations are enabled or disabled. Local only
Language Your preferred in-app language. Local only
Language Selected Whether the language selection screen has been completed. Local only

ℹ️ We do NOT collect your name, email, phone number, location, device ID, contacts, payment details, or any other personal information.

💾

Local Storage & No Network Access

P-03

All game data is stored privately in your device's internal storage. This data is:

  • Not accessible to other apps on your device
  • Never transmitted to any server, cloud service, or third party
  • Automatically deleted when you uninstall the game

Blast Blitz does not request any permissions on your device. No analytics SDK, crash reporter, or advertising network is included in the app.

✅ Tapping the Privacy Policy or Terms links opens your device's default browser — no personal data is passed in that process.

  • COPPA – Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (USA)

Your Rights & Data Control

P-06

Since all data is stored locally on your device, you have full control at all times:

View Data Your best score and settings are visible directly inside the game.
Delete Data Go to Settings → Apps → Blast Blitz → Storage → Clear Data on your Android device.
Remove All Uninstalling the app permanently deletes all stored game data from your device.
GDPR / CCPA No personal data is collected, so there is nothing to request, modify, or port. Contact us with any questions.

Gameplay, Scoring & Levels

T-03

Blast Blitz is an 8×8 grid block puzzle game. You drag blocks from a tray of up to 3 visible blocks onto the board. When a full row or column is filled, it is cleared and you earn points. The game ends when no block from the current tray can be placed anywhere on the board.

Tray: Up to 3 blocks are shown at a time (from a pool of 5). A new set is generated when all 3 are used.

Scoring System (from source code):

ActionPoints
Place a block on the board+0
Clear 1 line (row or column)+100
Clear 2 lines simultaneously+250
Clear 3 lines simultaneously+400
Clear 4+ lines simultaneously+600 (+100 per extra line)
Combo bonus (per consecutive combo)+50 × combo count

Level Multipliers: Each level applies a score multiplier. Higher levels reward more points per action.

LevelLines to AdvanceScore Multiplier
1310/10 (×1.0)
2511/10 (×1.1)
3712/10 (×1.2)
41013/10 (×1.3)
51515/10 (×1.5)
62017/10 (×1.7)
72520/10 (×2.0)
83022/10 (×2.2)
94025/10 (×2.5)
10 (Max)5030/10 (×3.0)

ℹ️ Scores are stored only on your device. There is no online leaderboard — your score cannot be submitted or compared externally.
